edges.reason: constructor uses msg.sender as the recipient of the initial _mint of totalSupply.
enableTrading writes lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp, a miner-influenced timestamp.
_transfer gates autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on block.timestamp >= lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency.
_transfer uses tx.origin as key in _holderLastTransferTimestamp for the one-purchase-per-block delay.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router addLiquidityETH deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens sets lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens requires block.timestamp > lastManualLpBurnTime + manualBurnFrequency and stores it.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swapBack branch in _transfer.
limitsInEffect gates the limit/trading checks in _transfer.
tradingActive determines whether non-excluded accounts may transfer.
automatedMarketMakerPairs is read to classify buys and sells and to decide swapping.sol
swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold for canSwap in _transfer.
maxTransactionAmount enforces per-trade caps in _transfer.
maxWallet enforces per-wallet balance caps in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFees controls the trading gate, swap gate and fee exemption in _transfer.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount exempts accounts from limit checks in _transfer.
transferDelayEnabled gates the anti-bot block-number restriction in _transfer.
swapping flag prevents recursive swapBack and disables fee taking during swaps.
lpBurnEnabled gates the automatic LP burn call in _transfer.
lpBurnFrequency is added to lastLpBurnTime in the _transfer timestamp check.
lastLpBurnTime (timestamp) is read in _transfer to decide when to burn LP.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp is read and written in _transfer for the anti-bot delay.
percentForLPBurn scales the amount of LP pair tokens to burn.
marketingWallet is the recipient of the final low-level ETH call in swapBack.
devWallet is the recipient of the low-level ETH call in swapBack.
tokensForMarketing drives ETH distribution and is reset in swapBack.
tokensForLiquidity drives liquidity sizing and is reset in swapBack.
tokensForDev drives dev ETH distribution and is reset in swapBack.
uniswapV2Router is approved and called in swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is approved and called in addLiquidity.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned from in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
uniswapV2Pair balance is read and burned from in manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
_transfer sets swapping=true then calls swapBack, which performs external calls before state is finalised.
_transfer calls autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when the burn window elapses.
_transfer invokes super._transfer to move the fee portion to the contract.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add the liquidity share back to the pool.
swapBack performs an external low-level ETH call to the mutable devWallet address.
swapBack performs an external low-level ETH call sending the entire remaining balance to marketingWallet.
devWallet can reenter _transfer during the ETH call before swapBack completes.
marketingWallet can reenter _transfer during the final ETH call in swapBack.
swapTokensForEth makes an external call into the router, handing control to an external contract.
addLiquidity makes an external payable call into the router.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls sync() on the external pair contract.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping entry.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees.
isExcludedFromFees reads _isExcludedFromFees.
onlyOwner on enableTrading resolves through owner().
onlyOwner on transferOwnership resolves through owner().
owner() returns the _owner storage variable.
owner() is compared against _msgSender() in the onlyOwner modifier.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller into access checks.
from parameter defines the source of the transfer and the fee/limit branches.
to parameter defines the destination and the buy/sell classification.
amount parameter is checked against limits and reduced by fees.
amount is used to compute fees passed to super._transfer.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount parameter is supplied as msg.value to router addLiquidityETH.
percent parameter scales the manual LP burn amount.
newAmount parameter is validated and stored as swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum parameter is scaled and stored as maxTransactionAmount.
newMarketingWallet parameter replaces marketingWallet.
account parameter is used as the key in _isExcludedFromFees.
local contract token balance determines canSwap in _transfer.
local fees value is accumulated, transferred and subtracted in _transfer.
local contractBalance is capped and split in swapBack.
local totalTokensToSwap is the denominator for ETH distribution in swapBack.
local ethBalance is split into marketing, dev and liquidity shares in swapBack.
local amountToBurn is computed and transferred to the dead address.

normalization_plan.reason: parameter from is only meaningful inside _transfer where it drives limit and fee branches.
parameter to is only meaningful inside _transfer where it classifies buys/sells.
parameter amount is a transient value consumed entirely by _transfer logic.
tokenAmount is only used to approve and swap within swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is only used as msg.value in the addLiquidity router call.
percent is a transient input scaling the burn inside the manual burn function.
newAmount is only validated and stored as swapTokensAtAmount.
newNum is only validated and stored as maxTransactionAmount.
newMarketingWallet is only assigned to the marketingWallet state variable.
account is only used as the mapping key and event argument in excludeFromFees.
local balance snapshot exists only to evaluate the swap trigger in _transfer.
local fees accumulator exists only within a single _transfer execution.
local contractBalance is a transient capped balance used only in swapBack.
local sum exists only as the distribution denominator inside swapBack.
local ETH delta is computed and immediately distributed within swapBack.
computed burn quantity is used and discarded within the auto burn function.
